participation_promise.collaborate: We look to you for advice and include your recommendations in the decision as far as possible.
participation_promise.consult: We listen to your concerns and report back how your input influenced the decision.
participation_promise.inform: We keep you informed with balanced and objective information.
participation_promise.involve: We work with you so that your concerns are reflected in the alternatives developed.

errors.approval_pending: An approval for this commitment is already running
errors.audience_required: A plan item needs at least one audience: stakeholders, categories or a body
errors.body_in_use: The body still holds letters in the mandate matrix
errors.body_inquorate: The deciding body does not have a quorum today, so no member can decide for it
errors.catalogue_retired: This framework is retired and cannot be pinned
errors.change_reason_required: The frame document is binding; give a reason for the change request
errors.change_request_not_open: A change request for this frame document is already open
errors.commitment_frozen: The text, the amount and the currency are fixed once the commitment is agreed; record a new commitment
errors.concurrent_change: Someone else changed this at the same time; reload and try again
errors.conflict_not_acknowledged: One person proposes and decides here; give a reason on that person's role before saving
errors.currency_required: An amount needs a three-letter currency, and the project has none to take it from
errors.display_name_required: A stakeholder without a contact needs a name
errors.document_not_binding: The frame document is not binding, so no change request is needed
errors.duplicate_code: The code is already used in this project
errors.frame_document_missing: The owner area has no frame document with a document container yet
errors.frame_document_read_only: The frame document is read-only and takes no new revision
errors.held_on_required: A held event needs the date it was held
errors.holder_required: A role holder needs a roster entry or a contact
errors.invalid_amount: The amount is not a valid number
errors.invalid_frequency: The frequency is not a supported recurrence rule
errors.invalid_letter: The letter must be P, D, A, C or I
errors.invalid_member: A member needs exactly one of role, user or contact
errors.invalid_parent: A stakeholder cannot sit below itself
errors.invalid_scores: The scores do not fit the analysis method
errors.invalid_source: The commitment source is not valid
errors.invalid_transition: This status change is not allowed
errors.invalid_validity: Valid to lies before valid from
errors.invalid_window: The calendar window must run forwards and cover at most two years
errors.mandate_missing: No role or body decides this decision type
errors.no_change_route: No approval route is pinned for changes to binding frame documents
errors.no_commitment_route: The framework routes commitments through an approval, but no route is set
errors.no_decision_route: No approval route is set for changes to frame documents
errors.no_pending_revision: The frame document has no newer revision to propose
errors.not_area_owner: Only the owner of the area may request a change to its binding frame document
errors.not_decider: You do not hold the deciding role for commitments to stakeholders
errors.owner_and_due_required: An agreed commitment needs an owner and a due date
errors.owner_cannot_verify: The owner of a commitment cannot verify it; someone else confirms that it was kept
errors.owner_change_needs_manage: Only someone who manages the organisation may change the owner of an agreed commitment
errors.pack_catalogue_invalid: The installed pack ships a framework that does not load
errors.project_stopped: The project was stopped at a gate; its frame documents take no changes
errors.release_item_required: A commitment with a cost needs a link to a release item before it is agreed
errors.release_items_unavailable: Release items cannot be linked because commitment release is not set up here
errors.role_not_multi: This role allows only one holder at a time
errors.schedule_or_trigger: A plan item needs either a start date with a frequency or a trigger
errors.self_approval_forbidden: The same person would propose and decide (or decide and co-sign) this decision type
errors.settings_missing: No stakeholder framework is pinned for this project
errors.two_deciders: A decision type may have only one deciding role or body per scope
errors.unknown_body: No governance body with this code
errors.unknown_category: The category is not in the pinned framework
errors.unknown_gate: This project has no such gate
errors.unknown_method: The analysis method is not in the pinned framework
errors.unknown_role: The role is not in the pinned framework
errors.user_not_project_member: The person is not a member of this project
errors.verification_needs_loop_closed: Verification needs the date the stakeholder was told, or a reason why that is not required

assessment_current.fail: Stakeholder {ref} is due for a review

body_quorate.fail: Body {ref} has fewer valid members than its quorum

commitment_has_owner_and_due.fail: Commitment {ref} has no owner or no due date
commitment_has_owner_and_due.suggestion: Set an owner and a due date

commitment_not_breached.fail: Commitment {ref} is overdue or breached without a rationale
commitment_not_breached.suggestion: Fulfil it, or confirm the breach with a rationale

feedback_reported.fail: Event {ref} promised feedback that was not reported in time

framework_scales_valid.fail: The stakeholder framework {ref} is not consistent

key_stakeholder_has_plan.fail: Key stakeholder {ref} has an engagement gap and no active communication plan
key_stakeholder_has_plan.suggestion: Add an active plan item for this stakeholder

mandate_no_self_approval.fail: One person proposes and decides (or decides and co-signs) {ref}
mandate_no_self_approval.suggestion: Give the roles to different people or acknowledge with a rationale

mandate_one_decider.fail: Decision type {ref} has no deciding role or body
mandate_one_decider.suggestion: Mark exactly one role or body with D

role_not_vacant.fail: Required role {ref} has no valid holder
role_not_vacant.suggestion: Name a holder for this role

stakeholder_has_category.fail: Stakeholder {ref} has a category the framework does not know
stakeholder_has_category.suggestion: Choose a category from the pinned framework
